entities.name: Axavar
entities.description: A Drix pirate of the Edge, once the unmatched Eldrazi hunter of the Drix, who severed his contract.

entities.name: Drix
entities.description: People who hunt Eldrazi and whose hunters now pursue Axavar.

entities.name: Fabric of All Being
entities.description: Medium Axavar uses to weftwalk and thwart his hunters.

events.summary: Weary of endless assassinations, Axavar questions the Drix's mission and severs his contract and his fate.
events.quote: So Axavar severed his contract and his fate

events.summary: Axavar uses the Fabric of All Being to thwart the Drix hunters sent after him.
events.quote: He now uses the Fabric of All Being to thwart his Drix hunters

relations.note: Now hunted by the Drix after leaving them.
relations.quote: He now uses the Fabric of All Being to thwart his Drix hunters
Axavar was once unmatched among the Drix's Eldrazi hunters
